description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Create a ready-to-use account from a supplied name, bio and category, without a website or Instagram. Skips onboarding and grants complimentary premium access for 12 months by default (or until compUntil), plus expiring inbox, website and Business Suite access. Website and suite grants can be switched off. No scraping, research, Stripe calls, email, SMS or password links. send_customer_welcome stays a separate human-requested step.

bio.description: The supplied business or personal bio; stored as businessAbout.

compUntil.description: Future ISO date or datetime. Defaults to creation time plus 12 calendar months.

email.description: The customer's login email. Trimmed and lowercased.

instagramUrl.description: Stored in provisioning metadata only. Never fetched.

websiteUrl.description: Stored on the profile only. Never fetched or researched.
